expect: PERFORMANCE_METRIC or FBA, Plan of Action
text:
Subject: Your FBA inbound privileges have been suspended

Date: 12 October 2026

Hello Lakeview Pet Goods,

Your FBA inbound shipping privileges are suspended because your inbound performance does not meet our requirements. Over the last 60 days, 14 of your 52 shipments were received with incorrect labels, and 6 arrived with prep errors (poly bags without suffocation warnings).

You cannot create new inbound shipments until the suspension is lifted. Inventory already in a fulfillment center is not affected.

To request reinstatement of your FBA privileges, submit a Plan of Action that explains the root cause of the labeling and prep errors, the actions you have taken, and your preventive measures. Plans are reviewed within 5 business days.

FBA Inbound Quality Team
Amazon.com

Subject: Action required: update your tax information

Date: 11 October 2026

Hello Orchard Row Goods,

We could not validate the tax information on your seller account. The name and taxpayer identification number you provided do not match the records we hold.

Please update your tax information in Seller Central (Settings > Account Info > Tax Information) within 14 days. If you do not, we may deactivate your selling account and withhold your funds.

If your information is correct, you may be asked to provide a copy of your IRS Form SS-4 confirmation letter (CP 575) or a Form W-9.

Amazon Tax Compliance

Subject: Your account health is at risk

Date: 10 October 2026

Hello Summit Trail Gear,

Your Order Defect Rate is currently 0.9%, which is below the 1% target, but it has increased over the last two weeks. Your Late Shipment Rate is 3.1% against a target of below 4%.

No action is required at this time. Keep monitoring your Account Health dashboard to make sure your performance stays within target.

Amazon Seller Performance

Subject: Your selling account has been deactivated

Date: 8 October 2026

Hello Willow & Stone Co.,

We have deactivated your selling account for the following reasons:

1. We received multiple customer complaints that items you sold were not authentic (ASIN B0CM3P7QZ4 and ASIN B0CM3R2LK9).
2. Your Order Defect Rate has been above 1% for the past 90 days (currently 2.4%).

To appeal, submit a Plan of Action that addresses both issues. For the authenticity complaints, include invoices from your supplier dated within the last 365 days. For the order defect rate, explain the root cause and the steps you are taking to reduce it.

Seller Performance Team
Amazon.com

Subject: Complete the account review questionnaire

Date: 9 October 2026

Hello Redfern Kitchen Supply,

We are reviewing your account. To continue selling, please answer the following questions in the appeal form in Seller Central within 10 days:

1. Describe your business model and how you source the products you sell.
2. Do you operate, or have you ever operated, other Amazon seller accounts? If so, list them.
3. What is the source of the inventory for ASIN B0CR8T4NV2?
4. Who is the beneficial owner of your business?

Incomplete answers may delay the review of your account.

Account Review Team
Amazon.com

Subject: Your selling account has been deactivated

Date: 7 October 2026

Hello Brightline Imports,

We verified the invoices you submitted for ASIN B0CT5N2YQ8 with the supplier named on them. The supplier confirmed that they did not issue these invoices. The documents you provided appear to have been altered or fabricated. As a result, your selling account has been permanently deactivated.

This decision is final. Our policies do not allow us to reinstate accounts that have submitted fraudulent documents.

Amazon Seller Performance

Subject: Your selling limits have been reduced

Date: 13 October 2026

Hello Pinewood Candle Co.,

Based on a review of your recent activity, we have set a limit on the number of units you can list in the Home category. The limit is 500 units per ASIN at any time.

This limit is not a suspension. As your sales history grows and your account stays in good standing, the limits may increase automatically.

Amazon Seller Support

Subject: URGENT: Seller account permanently closed in 24 hours

Dear Seller,

Your Amazon seller account will be permanently closed within 24 hours due to unusual activity. To reinstate your account immediately you must pay a reinstatement fee of $250 via gift cards and send the codes to our recovery agent on WhatsApp at +44 7700 900123. You can also verify your account by logging in at amazon-seller-verify.support-center.example and entering your password and the code we text you.

Failure to comply will result in permanent loss of your funds.

Amazon Account Recovery

Subject: Used sold as new complaints

Date: 6 October 2026

Hello Hartwell Tools,

We removed ASIN B0CV9K3PH6 because customers reported receiving items that were used or damaged but sold as new. Item condition complaints are a violation of our Seller Code of Conduct.

To appeal, send a Plan of Action explaining the root cause of the complaints, the actions you have taken, and your preventive measures. You may also be asked for the order IDs of the affected orders.

Seller Performance Team
Amazon.com

Hello Pinecrest Pet Supply,

Thank you for your Plan of Action. We have reviewed it and your selling account has been reinstated. You can start listing products again. Please keep your Late Shipment Rate below 4% to avoid further action.

Seller Performance Team

Hello Brightline Imports,

We have reviewed your appeal. Our decision to deactivate your account is final and we will not review further appeals or Plans of Action. Please do not submit another appeal.

Amazon Seller Performance

Hello Ridgeline Outdoor Supply,

Thank you for your appeal. We need more information before we can make a decision. Please send a copy of the invoice from the manufacturer that Summit Peak Wholesale bought the Trailhead tents from, and a letter from Trailhead Gear Co. confirming your supplier is authorized. Documents must be sent within 5 days.

Seller Performance Team

Hello Harbor & Pine Kitchenware,

We reviewed the information you sent and could not reinstate your listing. The information provided was not sufficient. You may submit a new appeal with additional information.

Amazon Seller Support

Subject: Action required: A-to-z Guarantee claims on your account

Date: 14 October 2026

Hello Foxglove Home,

Your A-to-z Guarantee claim rate is 1.8%, above our 1% target, and your account is at risk of deactivation. Customers claimed that items did not arrive or were not as described.

Please submit a Plan of Action within 7 days that explains what caused the claims and what you will do to prevent them.

Seller Performance Team
Amazon.com
